items.title: The inbox dropdown you asked for already exists; check it is easy to find
items.detail: You asked for a dropdown to pick All or a single account, plus add a temporary or a permanent address. Commit 1c4be58 already added this: an inbox picker with All, each mailbox with its unread count and problems, temporary addresses, and an add-an-address option. It replaced the long list. If you still see the old list, the picker may be hard to spot or not on every screen size. Fix: Open Mail at 375px, 820px and 1440px and confirm the picker shows in the list header everywhere. Show the current choice as the title with a chevron, like Gmail's account switcher. Make 'Add an address' open a choice between a temporary and a permanent address. (git commit 1c4be58 (Mail: inbox picker); the Mail list header in src/components/mail/)

items.title: On desktop, deleting a login uses the browser's own confirm box
items.detail: The native confirm() box ignores the app's theme and motion and looks out of place. On phones the app shows its own sheet, so the two sizes behave differently. Fix: Use the same confirm sheet (or a centred modal on desktop) that phones get through setConfirmDel. Add Undo to the 'Login deleted' toast. (src/components/VaultApp.tsx:309 and :562)

items.title: Copied usernames are never cleared from the clipboard
items.detail: Passwords clear after 30 seconds, but usernames do not. This is inconsistent with the promise shown in the vault footer. Fix: Copy usernames through the same copy-and-clear helper at line 71, or reword the footer so it only promises clearing for passwords. (src/components/VaultApp.tsx:319 and :491)

items.title: The login detail screen has an empty title
items.detail: PushScreen is given title="". Users lose track of which login they are looking at, and screen readers announce no heading. Fix: Pass it.meta.title as the title, letting it fade in as the page scrolls if the large header should stay. (src/components/VaultApp.tsx:757)

items.title: Deleting a team uses the browser's own confirm box and has no Undo
items.detail: It is a destructive action, and the native dialog does not match the app. Deleting a whole team deserves a proper sheet. Fix: Use a confirm sheet or modal that names the team and how many tasks move, with a red Delete button and Cancel. (src/components/teams/TeamsApp.tsx:730)

items.title: Deleting your account asks with the browser's own confirm box
items.detail: This is the most destructive action in the app, and it gets a plain dialog with no typed confirmation, unlike Google or 1Password. Fix: Use a modal where the user types their email or DELETE to enable a red button, and list what stays and what goes. (src/components/SettingsPage.tsx:1002 and :1017)

items.title: Phone drawer still lists every inbox; it needs the same dropdown as desktop
items.detail: The desktop sidebar already has a dropdown for choosing an inbox (InboxSwitcher), but the phone drawer still shows a flat list of All inboxes, each mailbox and each temporary address above the folders. With several addresses the folders get pushed below the fold, and choosing an inbox works differently on phone and desktop. This is the problem the user described. Fix: Replace the Inboxes nav group in the phone drawer with a switcher row like InboxSwitcher, placed under gm-drawer-head: the current inbox's icon, address and unread count, with a chevron. Tapping it opens the useActionMenu list as a bottom sheet with All inboxes, the mailboxes, the temporary addresses, New temporary address and Add an email address. Keep the tabNav and Assigned to me rows below it. (src/components/Sidebar.tsx:352-360)

items.title: Phone drawer hides All inboxes when there is one mailbox plus temporary addresses
items.detail: The drawer shows All inboxes only when boxes.length > 1, while the desktop shows it when there are several mailboxes or any temporary address (many = boxes.length > 1 || temps.length > 0). On a phone, a user with one mailbox and a temporary address can never view both together. Fix: Use the same condition as the desktop, boxes.length > 1 || temps.length > 0, or let the shared switcher component decide. (src/components/Sidebar.tsx:353 (compare src/components/mail/InboxSwitcher.tsx:34))

items.title: Add an email address is missing from the phone drawer
items.detail: The desktop menu offers admins Add an email address (onAddAccount). The phone drawer only offers Temporary address, so on a phone the only way to add a permanent mailbox is buried in Settings, which is the opposite of what the user asked for. Fix: Put both New temporary address and Add an email address in the add group of the shared switcher menu, and pass onAddAccount to the drawer. (src/components/Sidebar.tsx:388-396 (desktop has it at src/components/mail/InboxSwitcher.tsx:41))

items.title: New temporary address is filed under Projects/Clients in the phone drawer
items.detail: The Temporary address row is rendered inside the nav labelled with the projects term (term.Many), and that group also appears when no projects exist. People look for it next to their inboxes, as on the desktop, not among clients. Fix: Move it into the inbox switcher's add group and remove props.onNewTemp from the condition that shows the projects group. (src/components/Sidebar.tsx:388-396)

items.title: On a phone, picking a folder silently resets the inbox to All
items.detail: In the drawer, pick() calls onAccountFilter('all') whenever a folder is chosen. Someone viewing their work inbox who taps Sent sees Sent from every account, with nothing telling them it changed. Gmail keeps the chosen account while you move between folders, and the desktop does not reset it. Fix: Keep activeAccount when a folder is picked. Once the switcher shows the current inbox, people can choose All themselves. (src/components/Sidebar.tsx:337-340)

items.title: Temporary addresses shown as a cut-off 'name@' on the phone
items.detail: In the drawer, temporary inboxes are labelled a.email.split('@')[0] + '@', so two addresses on different domains look the same and the label reads like an unfinished string. The desktop shows the full address and how long it has left (lifeLeft). Fix: Show the full address and put lifeLeft(a) as the hint line, as InboxSwitcher's subOf does. (src/components/Sidebar.tsx:358)

items.title: Phone mailbox rows read 'My inbox' instead of the address
items.detail: When there are several mailboxes, the drawer names your own mailbox 'My inbox' and only shared or delegated ones by name. With two personal addresses, both rows say 'My inbox' and cannot be told apart. Fix: Label each row with a.email, as the desktop does (InboxSwitcher.tsx:38), and put Shared or Delegated in the hint line. (src/components/Sidebar.tsx:355)

items.title: Inbox problems (sync or auth errors) are not shown on the phone
items.detail: The desktop menu shows each account's error state under the address (state[a.id].label). The drawer's item() does not receive accountState, so on a phone a disconnected mailbox looks fine. Fix: Use the shared subOf hint, or pass accountState to the drawer and show a warning dot with the label. (src/components/Sidebar.tsx:355 (desktop: src/components/mail/InboxSwitcher.tsx:30))

items.title: No inbox indicator in the phone list header
items.detail: On a phone, the search pill avatar opens account and companies, not inboxes, so nothing on the list screen says which inbox is filtered. After the drawer closes, users cannot tell whether they are looking at All or one address. Fix: Show the current inbox's name as a small tappable chip under the search pill when activeAccount is not 'all', and have it open the switcher sheet. (src/components/MessageList.tsx:335 and src/components/mail/MailTop.tsx:11-35)

items.title: Desktop menu with a single inbox and no temporary addresses still opens a near-empty menu
items.detail: When many is false, the menu contains only the one mailbox plus the add actions, so the chevron suggests a choice that does not exist. Fix: When there is one mailbox, keep the button but rename the menu header to 'Add an address'. Alternatively, show the chevron only when many is true or an add action exists. (src/components/mail/InboxSwitcher.tsx:34-44)

items.title: Temporary address actions sit behind a separate small icon
items.detail: The copy/share/delete button only appears next to the switcher when a temporary inbox is active, and it is a 15px icon. Users who want to copy the address while on All cannot find it. Fix: Show a trailing more button on each temporary row inside the menu (as Gmail does for account management), and keep the one next to the switcher. (src/components/mail/InboxSwitcher.tsx:62-66)

items.title: Temporary addresses and mailboxes have no group headings in the menu
items.detail: The menu items have group keys ('boxes', 'temp', 'add') but no visible headings, so a temporary address looks like an ordinary mailbox, apart from its icon. Fix: Add small section headings 'Inboxes' and 'Temporary' (if useActionMenu supports group labels), or a divider with a caption. (src/components/mail/InboxSwitcher.tsx:38-41)

items.title: Brand colour dot only on desktop
items.detail: The desktop switcher shows a brand-dot for the current inbox, but the phone rows do not, so the same colour cue that ties mail to a brand is missing on a phone. Fix: Pass brandColor into the phone switcher row. (src/components/mail/InboxSwitcher.tsx:54 vs src/components/Sidebar.tsx:355)

items.title: Switcher duplicated in two implementations
items.detail: The inbox choice is built twice (InboxSwitcher for desktop, an item() list for the phone drawer), and every difference above comes from that. Keeping two copies means they will keep drifting apart. Fix: Render InboxSwitcher in the drawer too, with a 'sheet' option on phones (useActionMenu already supports sheets), and delete the boxes/temps item code. (src/components/Sidebar.tsx:326-360 and src/components/mail/InboxSwitcher.tsx)

items.title: Switcher button spacing is tight against Compose
items.detail: The .inbox-switch margin is 12px 0 4px, and the Folders heading follows right after, so the switcher card visually merges with the folder list. Fix: Use a margin of 12px 0 12px, or add a hairline separator before the Folders heading, so the switcher reads as its own control. (src/shell.css:2775-2780)

items.title: Activity chips have no hover state on desktop
items.detail: Every other desktop control in Chat responds to hover. The All/Mentions chips on the Activity page don't, so they look static and it's unclear they are clickable. Fix: Inside @media (hover: hover) add `.page-activity .act-chip:not(.on):hover { background: var(--hover); color: var(--text); }`. (src/components/chat/chat.css:1595-1611 (.page-activity .act-chip, no :hover rule anywhere in the file))

items.title: Reduced motion does not cover huddle tile and floater entrances
items.detail: Users who ask for reduced motion still see the tiles scale in, the tiles fade, and the reaction floaters slide in and out during a huddle. These are the busiest animations in the app. Fix: Add .ht-tile, .ht-* fade elements and the hf-in/hf-out elements to a prefers-reduced-motion block with `animation: none`. Keep a 0.15s opacity transition so they still fade both ways. (src/components/chat/chat.css:1330 (ht-in), 1354 (ht-fade), 1419 (hf-in), 1428 (hf-out); the reduce blocks at 1009, 1256 and 1516 omit them)

items.title: Reaction float is disabled under reduced motion by class name only, not by keyframe
items.detail: The rule turns off `.huddle-float` but the animated element uses huddle-float as its keyframe. If that element's class differs, emoji still fly up the screen for users who asked for less motion. Fix: Check the selector at line ~598 that owns the animation and add it to the reduce block at line 1009. Better, replace the travel with a short opacity-only fade. (src/components/chat/chat.css:604 (animation: huddle-float) vs 1012 (.huddle-float selector))

items.title: Message column is up to 1200px wide on desktop
items.detail: At 1440px with the sidebar open, message lines can run past 120 characters, which is hard to read. Slack and Discord let bubbles stretch, but text width stays near 720-800px. Fix: Keep the container at 1200px for attachments, and cap message text at about 72ch (`.msg-text { max-width: 72ch }`). Or lower the container to 960px. (src/components/chat/chat.css:1463 (max-width: 1200px))

items.title: Activity feed is capped at 760px and left-aligned on wide screens
items.detail: At 1180px and 1440px the feed sits on the left with a large empty area to its right. The page looks unbalanced next to the full-width conversation view. Fix: Add `margin: 0 auto` to .page-activity .act-feed, or match the conversation container width so switching pages doesn't jump. (src/components/chat/chat.css:1587-1589)

items.title: The 'View:' picker uses jargon and sits below the page list
items.detail: 'View: Company default' is not a term from Slack. New users can't tell it reorders the sidebar sections, and it sits below Activity, Catch up and the other pages instead of next to the channel list it controls. Fix: Turn it into a small 'Sort / Group' icon menu on the Channels section header, like Slack's sidebar sort options. Rename the options to 'Sections (default)', 'Unread first', 'Recent'. (src/components/ChatApp.tsx:443-463 (view-bar) and 230-235 (viewOptions labels))

items.title: Custom views duplicate Slack-style sections
items.detail: 'Create a view…' with its own sections and channels overlaps the admin-set sections and the per-channel section moves. Users end up with two ways to group channels and get confused about which one they are editing. Fix: Hide custom views behind a setting or remove them. Let users make personal sections directly in the sidebar, which is Slack's model. (src/components/ChatApp.tsx:234 ('__new' option), 237-240 (pickView), 1394 (view modal))

items.title: Status button sits above the page navigation
items.detail: In Slack and Discord your status lives with your avatar, at the top-right or bottom-left. Here a large emoji button is the first item in the Chat sidebar, which pushes Activity down and treats a rare action as primary. Fix: Move status into the user/avatar menu, or pin it to the bottom of the sidebar. Show only the emoji next to the avatar. (src/components/ChatApp.tsx:418-424)

items.title: Redundant sb-label class on the status button and its child
items.detail: The button and its inner span both carry sb-label. When the sidebar collapses to icons, the whole button, emoji included, is hidden, so collapsed users lose access to status. Fix: Remove sb-label from the button (line 418) and keep it only on the text span, so the emoji stays visible when the sidebar is collapsed. (src/components/ChatApp.tsx:418 and 420)

items.title: Phone filter button changes meaning by tab
items.detail: The same spot shows 'Filter' on DMs and 'Mark all as read' on Activity, and it disappears on Activity when there is nothing unread. That makes the header jump, and mark-all-read happens on one tap with only a toast and no undo. Fix: Put mark-all-read in an overflow menu or show it as a text button 'Mark all read', and add Undo to the toast. Keep the slot's width reserved so the header doesn't shift. (src/components/ChatApp.tsx:397-401 and 491)

items.title: Mark all as read has no undo
items.detail: One accidental tap clears every unread notice. The toast only confirms the action. Fix: Pass an undo action to the toast that calls onReadNotices(ids, false) with the ids it just cleared. (src/components/ChatApp.tsx:398 (toast({ text: t('All marked as read') })))

items.title: Phone home tab stacks up to five overlapping sections
items.detail: Tiles, the huddle banner, Unread DMs, Mentions, recent Direct messages and Starred all render above the channels. The same conversation can show up in Catch-up tiles and in the unread lists, so channels end up far below the fold at 375px. Fix: Show tiles collapsed by default, or keep only 'Unread' plus channels. Move Mentions to the Activity tab, where Slack puts them, and drop the recent DMs slice since there is already a DMs tab. (src/components/ChatApp.tsx:497-530)

items.title: Recent DMs on the phone home list are silently capped at 3
items.detail: The list stops at three with no 'See all' link, so users don't know more exist. Fix: Add a 'See all DMs' row that switches to the DMs tab, or remove this section. (src/components/ChatApp.tsx:521-526 (.slice(0, 3)))

items.title: Tiles are only reordered by long-press or a buried editor
items.detail: Hold-to-move is not discoverable, and the only hint is help text inside the tile settings. Fix: Drop tile reordering and keep just show/hide, or show an 'Edit' link at the end of the tile row. (src/components/ChatApp.tsx:1100-1108 (Tile useLongPress) and 1154)

items.title: /kudos is a niche feature in the main composer
items.detail: Kudos adds a separate form (Who? / For what?) to the conversation view. It isn't in Slack or Discord as a core action and adds clutter for most teams. Fix: Keep it as a slash command only, with no persistent UI, or move it behind a workspace setting that is off by default. (src/components/chat/Conversation.tsx:416 (/kudos) and 788-789 (form))

items.title: Huddle live dot pulses forever in the sidebar
items.detail: An endlessly pulsing green dot next to each live huddle pulls the eye constantly while users are trying to read. Fix: Pulse 3 times (`animation-iteration-count: 3`), then stay solid. Reduced motion already turns it off. (src/components/chat/chat.css:520 (animation: conn-pulse 1.4s infinite))

items.title: Huddle panel is a fixed 320px wide
items.detail: On iPad portrait (820px) with the sidebar open, a fixed 320px panel squeezes the conversation to about 250px. On desktop it doesn't grow. Fix: Use `width: clamp(280px, 28vw, 380px)`. Below 900px, show it as an overlay sheet instead of a side column. (src/components/chat/chat.css:1531-1533)

items.title: Tablet breakpoints are missing; only 767px is used
items.detail: Chat CSS only switches at 767/768px, so the 820px and 1180px iPad layouts get the full desktop sidebar, conversation and details panes at once and become cramped. Fix: Add a breakpoint at max-width 1100px that collapses the details pane into an overlay and narrows the sidebar to about 240px. (src/mobile/chat.css:5 and 17; src/components/chat/chat.css:1586)

items.title: Status picker explains automation in a paragraph
items.detail: The 'In a meeting is set for you automatically' footnote is long helper text inside a small popover. It adds noise every time someone opens it. Fix: Remove the line and show the automatic status as a preset row with a calendar icon and an 'Auto' label when it's active. (src/components/ChatApp.tsx:1146)

items.title: Sidebar has 10 views; Todoist has 4
items.detail: My tasks, Today, Upcoming, Supervising, My teams, My projects, Assigned by me, Briefs, Everything and Projects x teams all sit at the same level. A new user can't tell which one is home, and the three that matter get lost. Fix: Keep Today, Upcoming and My tasks at the top. Move Supervising, Assigned by me, My teams, My projects, Briefs, Everything and Projects x teams into a collapsible 'More views' fold (.fold plus .rot-chev) that is closed by default and whose open state is saved. (src/components/TasksSidebar.tsx:62-85)

items.title: Brain dump is the main button instead of Add task
items.detail: In Todoist the top action is 'Add task'. Here the compose button opens an AI brain-dump, so people looking for the plain way to add one task can't find it. Fix: Make the compose button 'Add task' (open QuickAdd), and offer Brain dump as a secondary menu item next to it, the way the phone already does at TasksView.tsx:388. (src/components/TasksSidebar.tsx:57-60)

items.title: Tasks sidebar still contains a full copy of the projects list and add form
items.detail: When projectsApp is false, Tasks shows the same project list, type chips, past toggle and add-project form as ProjectsSidebar. That's two places to create a project, and the two can drift apart. Fix: Delete this block. If projects are needed in Tasks, list them as filter rows only, with no add form, and link 'Manage projects' to the Projects app. (src/components/TasksSidebar.tsx:111-174)

items.title: The same red count badge means four different things
items.detail: Today counts late or due today, Supervising counts tasks to review, Assigned by me counts late tasks only, and Teams counts unassigned tasks. All use .warn-count, so a red '3' can't be read without knowing the rules. Fix: Keep red only for late work. Show to-review and unassigned counts as neutral .count, and give every count a title tooltip like the team and project rows already have. (src/components/TasksSidebar.tsx:65-70,99-101)

items.title: Smart-view counts have no tooltip
items.detail: The badges on Supervising and Assigned by me show a number without saying what it counts. Team and project badges do have a title. Fix: Add a fourth tuple field with the tooltip text and render <span className='count' title={hint}>. (src/components/TasksSidebar.tsx:83)

items.title: 'Projects x teams' and 'Briefs' don't belong in the main Tasks nav
items.detail: The project-by-team grid is an admin report, and briefs belong to a project. Both add noise to a personal to-do app. Fix: Move the grid to Projects (as a 'Grid' view toggle on the home) or to Admin. Show Briefs inside a project's Tasks tab only, or under the 'More views' fold. (src/components/TasksSidebar.tsx:71,75)

items.title: Phone and desktop list the views in a different order
items.detail: The desktop sidebar goes My tasks, Today, Upcoming. The phone browse list goes Today, Upcoming, My tasks. Someone who uses both has to relearn the order. Fix: Use the Todoist order everywhere: Today, Upcoming, My tasks. Build both lists from one shared array. (src/components/TasksSidebar.tsx:64-66 vs src/components/TasksView.tsx:319-321)

items.title: The task header has too many buttons
items.detail: On a project's task page the title row holds the type select, the status select, Stages, End work, people, the layout and Display slot, Template, Brain dump and Open the project. There is no clear primary action, and it wraps to two lines at 820 and 1180 px. Fix: Keep the title, people, the slot (layout, Display, New task) and one overflow menu. Move Stages, Template, Brain dump and End work into the overflow (useActionMenu). (src/components/TasksView.tsx:723-742,784-798)

items.title: Template button shows in every view
items.detail: 'Template' shows on Today, Upcoming and My tasks, where starting from a project template makes no sense. Fix: Render it only when client or project is set (wrap it in {(client || project) && ...}). (src/components/TasksView.tsx:786-788)

items.title: Reduced motion is respected for only one animation
items.detail: The only reduced-motion rule in tasks.css turns off .tbr-group. The fadeIn entrances at lines 869 and 1332 and the bulk-bar bulkUp/bulkDown animations still run for people who asked for less motion. Fix: Add those selectors to the reduced-motion block (animation: none), or use one global rule that sets animation-duration to 0.01ms under prefers-reduced-motion. (src/mobile/tasks.css:1435-1439 (also 869,1272-1275,1332))

items.title: Type filter chips are smaller than the 12 px minimum
items.detail: The chips use 11.5 px text and 2 px vertical padding. That's below the CLAUDE.md minimum of 12 px for labels and far below a 44 px tap target on iPad touch. Fix: Use font-size 12px and padding 4px 10px, and set min-height var(--tap) under (pointer: coarse). (src/polish.css:1155-1164)

items.title: Empty state uses a text checkmark instead of an icon
items.detail: icon='✓' renders a glyph that doesn't match the lucide icons used in the other empty states, so this one looks unfinished. Fix: Use icon={<CircleCheck size={20} />}. (src/components/tasks/TaskViews.tsx:460)

items.title: 'Brain dump' isn't explained anywhere
items.detail: The name doesn't say what the button does (turn free text into tasks with AI). The empty state is the only place that hints at it. Fix: Add a hint line in the menu item, such as 'Paste notes, get tasks', or rename it to 'Add from notes'. (src/components/TasksSidebar.tsx:59; src/components/tasks/TaskViews.tsx:395)

items.title: Type filter is shared with Projects without saying so
items.detail: Both sidebars save the filter under the same key, 's2g-project-type'. Choosing a type in Projects silently filters the project list in Tasks, and the reverse. Fix: Remove the copy in TasksSidebar (see the duplicate list finding), or give each app its own key. (src/components/TasksSidebar.tsx:32; src/components/ProjectsSidebar.tsx:30)

items.title: 'Everything' is admin-only with no explanation
items.detail: Admins see an extra view called 'Everything' with no hint of what it holds. Non-admins never see it, which makes support conversations confusing. Fix: Rename it to 'All company tasks' and put it under the More views fold with a short hint. (src/components/TasksSidebar.tsx:72-77)

items.title: Desktop sorts the projects twice; the phone keeps a different order
items.detail: rows are sorted with late work first, then each desktop group re-sorts by name, so the first sort is wasted. The phone keeps the late-first order. The same project sits in a different spot on each device. Fix: Sort by name once in rows (as Basecamp does, so cards stay where you left them) and drop the per-group sort. Late projects already stand out through their badge. (src/components/ProjectsHome.tsx:74 and 215 (phone uses rows order at 128-130))

items.title: Two different New project forms
items.detail: The sidebar form asks for name, email domain and type. The home form (and the phone sheet) asks only for name and type. Where you start decides what you get asked, and 'Email domain' is jargon. Fix: Use one form component everywhere: name and type, with domain under 'More options' and the hint 'mail from this domain files here'. The sidebar compose button should open the home form or a dialog, not a cramped form inside the sidebar. (src/components/ProjectsSidebar.tsx:62-75 vs src/components/ProjectsHome.tsx:83-114)

items.title: New project form is squeezed into the sidebar
items.detail: The sidebar's compose button opens the form inside a narrow column, with two text fields, a select and two buttons. That's tight at 1180 px and doesn't work when the sidebar is collapsed to icons. Fix: Make the compose button call the same setAdding as the home (lift the state up or use useCreateAction), so the form opens above the grid. (src/components/ProjectsSidebar.tsx:54-76)

items.title: Status pills have no dark-mode colors
items.detail: .proj-state.ok and .bad use fixed light hex values (#dcfce7, #fee2e2) with no dark rule. In dark mode they're bright pastel blocks on dark cards. Fix: Use tokens: background color-mix(in srgb, var(--ok) 15%, transparent) with color var(--ok), and the same for danger. (src/polish.css:2637-2648)

items.title: Card cascade animation ignores reduced motion
items.detail: Every .proj-card animates in with a stagger of up to 360 ms, and there is no prefers-reduced-motion rule for it. Fix: Add @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .proj-card { animation: none; } .proj-card:hover { transform: none; } }. (src/polish.css:2599-2600)

items.title: Card-field settings are a feature to remove
items.detail: A sliders button lets each person pick which of six fields cards show. Basecamp has nothing like it. It adds a control to the header, and unticking everything leaves blank cards. Fix: Remove the popover and always show type, state, next deadline and last activity. Keep 'people' off. (src/components/ProjectsHome.tsx:55-58,167-188)

items.title: Status pill joins up to three warnings
items.detail: '2 late · 1 not picked up · 1 waiting on client' in one rounded pill wraps across lines on a 260 px card and is hard to scan. Fix: Show only the worst issue in the pill, plus '+N' with the rest in a title tooltip, the way the phone's hint() does at line 119. (src/components/ProjectsHome.tsx:223,251-259)

items.title: Search box appears only after more than 6 projects
items.detail: The search box shows up at 7 projects, which shifts the header. Basecamp always has a 'Find' box. Fix: Always render the search box, or reserve its width. (src/components/ProjectsHome.tsx:161-166)

items.title: Past projects are hard to find on desktop
items.detail: The phone lists 'Past projects' on the home. Desktop has it only as a toggle at the end of the sidebar. Fix: Add a muted 'Past projects (N)' link under the last group on desktop that calls onPast. (src/components/ProjectsHome.tsx:209-271)

items.title: 'Past projects' toggle opens a list and also navigates
items.detail: Clicking once expands the past list and also opens the Past scope. Clicking again collapses the list but leaves you on Past, which feels broken. Fix: Make it navigate only, since the Past page already lists them. Remove the showPast expansion, or put it on a separate chevron. (src/components/ProjectsSidebar.tsx:108-120)

items.title: Phone 'Past projects' row has no group title
items.detail: The past group has no title, so it reads as a stray row after Paused. Fix: Give it a title (t('Archive')), or render it as a footer link styled as muted. (src/components/ProjectsHome.tsx:131)

items.title: A project has 12 parts; Basecamp has about 6
items.detail: Overview, Tasks, Workload, Quotes, Chat, Mail, Meetings, Files, Notes, Tables, Logins and Guests are all shown by default, so the tab row and the phone section list are long. Fix: Show Overview, Tasks, Chat, Mail, Files and Notes by default. Hide Workload, Tables and Logins (people can turn them back on in tab settings), and show Quotes only when a quote exists. (src/components/ProjectPhone.tsx:38-54)

items.title: Same parts get different names and icons
items.detail: The right-click menu says 'Emails' with MessagesSquare and FolderOpen, while the tabs say 'Mail' with Hash and FileText. The same part looks different depending on where you open it. Fix: Use projectTabIcon() and the projectTabs names in the right-click menu. (src/components/ProjectsHome.tsx:42-44 vs src/components/ProjectPhone.tsx:27-30,46)

items.title: Every non-danger action row gets the template icon
items.detail: ProjectSections draws LayoutTemplate for every action that isn't destructive, whatever the action actually does. Fix: Add an icon field to the action type and render a.icon. (src/components/ProjectPhone.tsx:116)

items.title: End work is a plain ghost button in the header
items.detail: Ending a project is a big step, but the button is styled like Stages and sits right next to it. Fix: Move it into an overflow menu with danger styling and a confirm step, or Undo, like ProjectsHome:48. (src/components/TasksView.tsx:739-741)

items.title: Arrow on project cards appears only on hover
items.detail: The arrow fades in only on hover, so it never shows on an iPad (820 or 1180 px touch), and the card footer looks empty. Fix: Under (hover: none), show the arrow at opacity 0.5. (src/polish.css:2660-2668)

items.title: Phone Month ignores the date picked in the month drop-down
items.detail: If you pick 20 Nov from the title's mini month, the list under the grid shows 1 Nov (or today) instead of the 20th, so the date you chose seems to have been ignored. Fix: Start `picked` from `cursor` when cursor falls in the month, and reset it whenever the cursor's day changes (key on cursor.toDateString(), not only the month): `setPicked(inMonth(cursor) ? cursor : inMonth(today) ? today : first)`. (src/components/calendar/MonthView.tsx:79-86 (PhoneMonth picked/shownKey reset))

items.title: Desktop event panel covers the end of the week
items.detail: The detail card is pinned 340px wide over the right edge of the grid. In Week view at 1180px and 1440px it hides Fri to Sun, which is often the event you just clicked, and you can't see what you're editing. Fix: Do what Google does and anchor the card beside the clicked event, flipping left when the event is in the right half. Or, if you keep a fixed panel, give the grid a matching right margin while it's open, animated with a grid-template-columns transition. (src/calendar.css:498-510 (.ev-detail absolute right:16px width:340px))

items.title: Desktop event card has no Duplicate, Copy link or Move
items.detail: On desktop the open event only shows Edit, Delete and Close. Duplicate and Copy link are only in the right-click menu, which most people never find. Google's card has a ⋮ menu for these. Fix: Pass `more={detailMore(selected)}` on desktop too and draw a ⋮ icon button in .ev-actions that opens it as an ActionSheet popover. (src/components/calendar/EventDetail.tsx:65-83 (actions); CalendarView.tsx:488 passes `more` only on phones)

items.title: RSVP buttons are in a different order on phone and desktop
items.detail: Desktop shows Yes, Maybe, No and phones show Yes, No, Maybe. Anyone who uses both taps the wrong answer. Fix: Use one order everywhere: Yes, No, Maybe (Google's on both platforms). (src/components/calendar/EventDetail.tsx:96-106)

items.title: Notetaker controls use three different words
items.detail: The same feature reads 'Record this meeting', 'Send notetaker' and 'Don't record' depending on timing. 'Record' sounds like screen or video capture, so people don't know what will happen. Fix: Use one verb pair: 'Notetaker joins' as a switch row (on or off), and 'Send notetaker now' only inside 15 minutes. Drop 'Record this meeting' and 'Don't record'. (src/components/calendar/EventDetail.tsx:178-198)

items.title: Location row repeats the call app name
items.detail: Events whose location is 'Google Meet' or 'Zoom' get a map-pin row reading 'Google Meet' right under the Join Google Meet button. That's noise, and it looks like a physical place. Fix: Use the existing helper: `const place = placeOf(event, link?.url); {place && <Row icon={<MapPin/>}>{place}</Row>}`. (src/components/calendar/EventDetail.tsx:202)

items.title: Five views in a segmented control on desktop
items.detail: Day, Week, Month, Schedule and 3 days fill the header and push the title and arrows together at 1180px. '3 days' is a phone view that desktop users rarely need. Google puts the views in one drop-down. Fix: On desktop, show one 'Week ▾' Select (the one already used for `narrow`) for all widths, and drop '3day' from the desktop list. Keep shortcuts D/W/M/A. (src/components/CalendarView.tsx:133 (views list) and 401-407 (segmented))

items.title: Tablet Today button is just a number
items.detail: Under 720px (iPad portrait beside the panel) Today becomes a small calendar tile showing '15'. It reads as a date label, not a button that jumps to today. Fix: Keep the text 'Today' button at tablet widths (it is only about 60px). Use the number tile on phones only, where the top bar is Google's. (src/components/CalendarView.tsx:382-385)

items.title: Folded mini month is still in the tab order
items.detail: When the month drop is closed, its 42 day buttons and 12 month buttons can still be focused with Tab. Keyboard users tab through invisible dates before reaching the grid. Fix: Add `tabIndex={open ? 0 : -1}` to .md-day and .md-month buttons and to the arrow buttons, or put `inert` on the fold when closed. (src/components/calendar/MonthDrop.tsx:90-96 and 145-150 (no tabIndex); the bare chips at line 114 already do it right)

items.title: Up next Join link stays focusable after it folds
items.detail: The strip keeps the last meeting while folding away (aria-hidden), but its Join link and title button stay focusable, so Tab lands on an invisible Join. Fix: Add `inert={!e || undefined}` to the .fold wrapper, or tabIndex -1 on .cu-main and .cu-join when `!e`. (src/components/calendar/UpNext.tsx:32-46)

items.title: Schedule says 'Nothing planned after this' while still loading
items.detail: The end line shows as soon as the list renders, even though more weeks load on scroll (up to two years). It tells people their future is empty when it hasn't been checked yet. Fix: Only show the text when `weeks >= MAX_WEEKS`. Before that, keep an empty sentinel of the same height. (src/components/calendar/ScheduleView.tsx:210-212)

items.title: Schedule needs an 'Earlier' button to scroll back
items.detail: Google's schedule loads earlier days as you scroll up. Here you have to notice and tap an 'Earlier' pill at the very top, so scrolling up just stops. Fix: Put an IntersectionObserver on a top sentinel that calls `earlier()` (which already keeps the scroll position), and remove the button. (src/components/calendar/ScheduleView.tsx:162-164 and 118-124)

items.title: Phone quick create hides More options and always uses the first calendar
items.detail: The sheet has no calendar choice and no Event/Task switch (Google has both). The full editor only opens if you tap the date line or swipe up, and nothing says so. Fix: Add a visible 'More options' text button in the sheet's footer, and an Event / Task segmented control above the title, since onSave already takes a kind. (src/components/calendar/QuickCreate.tsx:42 (calendars[0].id) and 100-102 (qc-when is the only way to More))

items.title: 'Move to tomorrow' on every event, including meetings with guests
items.detail: One click silently moves a meeting with other people to tomorrow. Google has no such action. It makes sense for task blocks, but for meetings it's a trap. Fix: Only offer it when `props.taskOf?.(e)` or the event has no guests. Otherwise leave it out. (src/components/CalendarView.tsx:285 and 306)

items.title: Clicking an empty Month day opens the New event dialog straight away
items.detail: On desktop Month, any stray click in a cell opens a full modal at 9:00. Clicking to focus the window or to deselect an event ends up creating one. Fix: First click on a cell closes any open event (deselect). Then use Google's light quick-add popover anchored to the cell, with 'More options' going to the dialog. (src/components/calendar/MonthView.tsx:168 (GridMonth cell onClick → onCreate(nine(d))))

items.title: Tapping the picked day again switches to Day view
items.detail: In phone Month, a second tap on the selected date leaves Month for Day view. Nothing signals this, and iOS Calendar doesn't do it, so it feels like an accidental jump. Fix: Make the second tap do nothing. Make the day heading above the list (.mp-list-head) a button that opens the day. (src/components/calendar/MonthView.tsx:106 (onClick: on ? onDay(d) : setPicked(d)))

items.title: Dead phone code in GridMonth
items.detail: MonthView sends phones to PhoneMonth, so GridMonth's phone branches never run. They add upkeep and confusion for whoever fixes the next bug. Fix: Remove the phone branches, the PhoneChip component and the matching .mg-chips/.mg-more-n CSS. (src/components/calendar/MonthView.tsx:164-166, 184-187, 204-211 (PhoneChip) and the mg-chips styles)

items.title: Leftover CSS for the removed New event button
items.detail: The .cal-new rule styles a header button that no longer exists (commit c08b0d6 removed the repeated primary button). Fix: Delete the @container rule for .cal-new span. (src/calendar.css:1094-1098)

items.title: 'Now' and 'now' in different cases
items.detail: The Up next strip shows 'Now', but startsIn() returns lowercase 'now', so the same state reads differently in different spots. Fix: Make startsIn return 'Now' (or reuse one helper) so all three spots match. (src/components/calendar/calTools.ts:47 (startsIn) vs UpNext.tsx:37 and EventDetail.tsx:155)

items.title: Delete, regenerate and clear use the browser's confirm()
items.detail: Deleting a meeting with its recording, or wiping all tasks, pops a grey system dialog with no animation and no Undo. It breaks the app's look and the bar's 'Toast with Undo' rule. Fix: Use the app's ActionSheet / RepeatScope-style confirm for regenerate and recording deletion. For Delete meeting and Clear all tasks, delete straight away with a toast that has Undo, keeping the data for 10 seconds. (src/components/MeetApp.tsx:486-487, 680 (keep select) and 823)

items.title: Desktop meeting header repeats its More menu
items.detail: The header shows Make bot leave, Regenerate notes, Share and Delete as buttons, and the ⋯ menu next to them lists the same four again. Duplicate controls make people unsure which one to use. Fix: Keep Share (and Make bot leave while live) as buttons, and put Regenerate, Who can see this, Bot log and Delete only in ⋯, as Read AI does. (src/components/MeetApp.tsx:536-556 (buttons) vs 490-496 (more menu items))

items.title: Header crammed with folder, type and filing note
items.detail: Back link, status, Folder picker, Type picker, 'auto-filed', four buttons and ⋯ share one row. At 820px it wraps or squeezes, and the meeting title sits below all of it. Fix: Move Folder and Type into the 'At a glance' card (as the phone's m-facts rows do), and keep the header to Back, status and actions. (src/components/MeetApp.tsx:521-535)

items.title: 'Bot' and 'notetaker' used for the same thing
items.detail: Audit 1 settled on one notetaker name, but the dialog title says 'Send the bot to a meeting', the action says 'Make bot leave', and empty states say 'send the bot'. 'Bot' also sounds less trustworthy to meeting guests. Fix: Rename to 'Send notetaker', 'Ask notetaker to leave' and 'Notetaker log', and update the empty-state copy and the Indonesian strings. (src/components/MeetApp.tsx:492, 539, 1306, 1470, 1473; MeetPhone.tsx:392)

items.title: Settings has three names
items.detail: The desktop sidebar says 'Filing rules & settings', the phone drawer says 'Settings', and the Folders screen and push screen say 'Meet settings'. People can't tell whether these are the same place. Fix: Use 'Meet settings' everywhere and move it to the bottom of the sidebar, away from the folder list. (src/components/MeetApp.tsx:152; MeetPhone.tsx:63, 73, 437)

items.title: Same pages named differently on phone and desktop
items.detail: Desktop has 'Meetings' and 'Upcoming'. Phone has 'Home', 'Coming up' and 'Past meetings'. Someone switching devices can't find the same screen. Fix: Pick one pair, for example 'Meetings' and 'Upcoming', and use it in the drawer, headers and the 'See all' screen. (src/components/MeetApp.tsx:122, 392; MeetPhone.tsx:50, 238, 306)

items.title: Unfiled count is shown as a warning
items.detail: An amber 'warn' badge on Unfiled makes unsorted meetings look like an error, even though filing is optional. It nags without pointing to a real problem. Fix: Use the plain .count style, or no count at all, since the phone already says 'N to file'. (src/components/MeetApp.tsx:148 (count warn-count))

items.title: Auto-join explanation contradicts the chosen mode
items.detail: Admins always read 'It joins a minute before each meeting… for everyone', even when they set the mode to 'Only meetings I accepted'. The text says the opposite of what they chose. Fix: Build the sentence from the mode label for admins too, for example '{mode}, a minute before the start. Read only: it never changes your calendar.' (src/components/MeetApp.tsx:1224-1227; MeetPhone.tsx:88-91)

items.title: Upcoming rows show the notetaker state twice
items.detail: A row can show 'The notetaker will join' as text and also a 'Notetaker joins' switch. On a 820px row, along with Join and Send now, that's four controls fighting for space. Fix: Keep the switch only, labelled 'Notetaker'. Drop the separate 'will join' line and the 'set by you' meta. (src/components/MeetApp.tsx:1260-1264 and 1284-1299)

items.title: Upcoming lists calls the notetaker can't join
items.detail: In-person and no-link events show up with 'No meeting link' and nothing you can do. Read AI lists only meetings with a joinable link, so the useful rows get buried. Fix: Filter `soon` to events with linkOf(e) non-null. Optionally add a folded 'N without a call link' line at the end. (src/components/MeetApp.tsx:1197 (soon filter) and 1255)

items.title: Phone 'Coming up' sheet is a dead end
items.detail: Tapping a coming meeting opens a sheet with read-only text. It has no Join button and no notetaker switch, only 'Open in Calendar', so people can't do the obvious next step. Fix: Add a primary 'Join {app}' (when within 10 minutes) and the notetaker switch row to the sheet. Keep 'Open in Calendar' as the secondary action. (src/components/MeetPhone.tsx:164-185)

items.title: Mic / MicOff icon toggle is unclear
items.detail: A crossed-out mic usually means 'you are muted', not 'the notetaker won't join'. Tapping it changes state with no confirmation. Fix: Use a labelled switch or a small 'Notetaker on/off' pill, and show a toast ('The notetaker won't join Standup' with Undo) when it changes. (src/components/MeetPhone.tsx:153-162)

items.title: Empty states use developer language
items.detail: Messages like 'notes need a transcript and an AI provider in Se…', '(automatic tasks are off or were cleared)' and '(captions must be on in the meeting)' explain the system instead of telling the user what to do. Fix: Rewrite as next steps: 'No notes for this meeting. Regenerate notes' as a button, and 'Waiting for people to talk.' Move the reasons into the notetaker log. (src/components/MeetApp.tsx:811, 831, 881)

items.title: Deleting the recording is done from a 'Keep' drop-down
items.detail: Picking a different option in a Select permanently deletes video or audio. Destructive actions hidden in a picker are easy to trigger by mistake. Fix: Show what's kept as text, plus a 'Delete recording' danger action in ⋯ that asks for confirmation with the app's own dialog. (src/components/MeetApp.tsx:674-689)

items.title: Phone filter chips 'Recording' and 'Failed' are unclear
items.detail: 'Recording' could mean 'live now' or 'has a recording'. 'Failed' puts diagnostics on the home screen, which Read AI keeps out of sight. Fix: Use All, Has tasks, Live now. Show failed meetings with a red status on the row instead of a filter. (src/components/MeetPhone.tsx:186-191 (FILTERS))

items.title: Phone Folders screen repeats the drawer
items.detail: Tasks from meetings and Unfiled show both in the drawer and as 'folders' on the Folders screen. They aren't folders, and the duplication muddles the navigation. Fix: Remove the Tasks and Unfiled rows from MeetFolders, so it lists only real folders. (src/components/MeetPhone.tsx:416-417 vs 50-52)

items.title: Ask AI is offered in four places
items.detail: The sidebar has an 'Ask AI' item that opens a panel instead of a page, and the meeting page offers it in the header, the ⋯ menu and the At a glance card. That clutters the page, and the sidebar item behaves differently from its neighbours. Fix: Keep one 'Ask about this meeting' in the At a glance card. Remove it from ⋯ and move the global Ask AI to the app's docked Ask AI pill instead of a nav item. (src/components/MeetApp.tsx:130, 491, 734, 1149)

items.title: Native checkbox and inconsistent labels in tasks and access
items.detail: The access popover uses a raw <input type=checkbox> against the app's switch style. Task checks are labelled 'Toggle done' on one row type and 'Mark done' or 'Reopen' on another. Fix: Use the app's .switch button with role=switch for 'Allow download', and use the Mark done / Reopen aria-label on both task row types. (src/components/MeetApp.tsx:916 and 1016 vs 1003)

items.title: 'No open tasks. Nice.' empty state
items.detail: A chatty line on a work screen. The bar asks for plain, specific copy. Fix: Use 'No open tasks from meetings.' (src/components/MeetApp.tsx:1116)

items.title: No visible file actions on iPad (touch, 768px and up)
items.detail: At 820 and 1180 px on a touch iPad, the '…' button is hidden and the star/trash buttons only appear on hover. Touch users get no visible way to act on a file except a long-press they have no reason to try. Fix: Add @media (hover: none) { .d-more { display:inline-grid } .d-actions { opacity:1; transform:none } } or show .d-more on every pointer:coarse device, the way Google Drive on iPad shows ⋮ on each tile. (src/mobile/drive.css:10-12 (.d-more display:none outside phones); src/shell.css:1499-1527 (.d-actions opacity 0 until :hover))

items.title: Preview shows developer text to users
items.detail: 'Previews for documents arrive with the real file server.' and 'Sample video. Upload your own…' are build notes. They make the product feel unfinished. Fix: Replace with a user-facing fallback: the file icon, name and size plus 'No preview for this file type' and Download / Open buttons. Drop the sample-video note or show it only in demo workspaces. (src/components/DrivePreview.tsx:105 and :112)

items.title: Trash has no 'Empty trash'
items.detail: Google Drive users expect one 'Empty trash' button. Here they have to delete each item forever one at a time, and the desktop only shows a note about 30 days. Fix: Add an 'Empty trash' text button on the right of the trash note (desktop) and on the phone's dp-sort row when section==='trash'. Ask for confirmation in a sheet and offer one Undo toast. (src/components/DriveView.tsx:358 (trash note only); :167-171 (per-item menu))

items.title: 'Delete forever' leaves sub-folders' files orphaned
items.detail: Deleting a trashed folder forever removes only its direct children. Grandchildren stay in data with a missing parent, so they never show anywhere, or they reappear later. Fix: Collect every descendant id recursively (walk parentId) and remove them all. Keep the snapshot Undo as it is. (src/App.tsx:3623 (filter i.id !== id && i.parentId !== id))

items.title: 'Delete forever' uses an X icon
items.detail: An X reads as close or dismiss, so a permanent delete sits next to Restore looking harmless. Fix: Use Trash2 (or a Trash with X) and the danger colour on hover. Keep the title 'Delete forever'. (src/components/DriveView.tsx:129-131 and :170)

items.title: Desktop can't sort, the phone can
items.detail: Phones get a Name / Last modified / Size sort sheet. On desktop the list header is static (cursor: default), so people can't sort by date or size the way Google Drive allows. Fix: Make Name / Modified / Size header cells buttons that reuse the same persisted 'pm-drive-sorts' and sorter(). Show an arrow on the active column and add a 'Sort' dropdown in grid mode. (src/components/DriveView.tsx:369-373 (static d-th); src/shell.css:1555-1567 (.d-th cursor default); phone sort at :492-507, :693-712)

items.title: Desktop file menu is missing Details
items.detail: The phone menu has 'Details' (type, location, uploader). The right-click menu on desktop doesn't, so desktop users can't see where a file lives or who uploaded it. Fix: Add { label:'Details', icon: Info, group:'file' } to menuFor. On desktop, open DetailsScreen content in a right-side panel (Google Drive's 'i' panel). (src/components/DriveView.tsx:166-183 (menuFor) vs :241 (phone Details))

items.title: Opening from the phone menu breaks swipe-through
items.detail: Tapping a row opens the viewer with the whole folder, but 'Open' in the … menu passes [i]. The same file then has no prev/next and no count, which is inconsistent. Fix: Pass the current folder's files list to phoneMenu's Open, the same way the row tap does. (src/components/DriveView.tsx:234 (props.onOpen(i, [i])) vs :616 (props.open(i, files)))

items.title: Trashing in the viewer closes it instead of moving on
items.detail: Google Drive and Photos move to the next item after a delete. Here the viewer closes, and someone cleaning up a folder has to reopen it every time. Fix: After onTrash, call onNav(next ?? prev) when either exists, and close only when the list is empty. (src/components/DrivePreview.tsx:84-87)

items.title: Viewer's Download and Share link are limited
items.detail: Download only shows for local blob uploads, and Share link never appears, though both are in the file menu. People expect them in the viewer's top bar (Drive puts them there). Fix: Show Download whenever item.url exists (the same download() helper as DriveView:153) and add a Link2 'Copy link' button when the url is not data:. (src/components/DrivePreview.tsx:72-76)

items.title: Flipping files zooms in from the centre in every direction
items.detail: Every next/prev re-keys .lb-stage and runs zoomIn, so the motion doesn't follow the arrow or swipe direction. It reads as reopening rather than moving along. Fix: Track the direction in state and apply a .from-left / .from-right class that slides 24px with a fade (200ms ease-out). Keep zoomIn only for the first open, and turn it off under prefers-reduced-motion. (src/components/DrivePreview.tsx:99 (key=item.id); src/shell.css:1672-1679 (animation: zoomIn))

items.title: No swipe down to close the viewer on phones
items.detail: iOS Photos and Drive close a preview with a downward swipe. Here only the small X does, at the top edge, which is hard to reach. Fix: In onTouchEnd, close when dy > 100 and |dy| > |dx|*1.5. Have the stage follow the finger and fade the backdrop while dragging. (src/components/DrivePreview.tsx:45-54 (only sideways is handled))

items.title: Wrong empty-state copy for Media, Email and Recent on phones
items.detail: Media and Email attachments fall through to 'Files you open, upload or get show here, newest first.' That copy doesn't explain those sections. Fix: Add cases: media → 'Photos and videos you upload or receive show here.'; email → 'Attachments from your emails appear here automatically.' (and drop the separate drive-note above it). (src/components/DriveView.tsx:582-595)

items.title: Phone grid tiles hide stars and dates
items.detail: In grid mode the tile shows only the name, so starred files and recent changes can't be told apart, unlike the list rows. Fix: Add a small filled star before the name when starred, and a one-line date under the name (fs-secondary, text-3). (src/components/DriveView.tsx:641-645)

items.title: Search results don't say where a file is
items.detail: The search covers every folder and email attachments, but the results show no location. Two files with the same name look identical, and the breadcrumb is replaced by 'Search results'. Fix: In search mode, add a 'Location' column in list view and a 'in Folder / Sub' line in the card meta (reuse pathOf from MoveSheet:771). (src/components/DriveView.tsx:82 (search across all live), :312-313, :375-387)

items.title: Recent quietly stops at 30 files
items.detail: Recent stops at 30 items with no 'show more', so older files seem to be gone. Fix: Group Recent by Today / This week / Earlier with lazy paging, or add a 'Show more' row after 30. (src/components/DriveView.tsx:87 and :549)

items.title: Folded sidebar shows a column of letter tiles
items.detail: With the sidebar collapsed, every note becomes a 28px first-letter tile. Several notes start with the same letter, so the tiles can't be told apart and they look like app icons. Apple Notes hides the list. Fix: When .sidebar.collapsed, hide .notes-nav entirely and keep only the New note and a search icon. Remove the ni-dot span. (src/polish.css:2883-2912; src/components/notes/NotesList.tsx:335-337)

items.title: Recently deleted is hard to find on desktop
items.detail: On desktop it sits under the whole list, below the last month, and it isn't in the 'Show' dropdown, while the phone's title menu includes it. Apple Notes lists it as a folder. Fix: Add a 'Recently deleted' option (group 'More') to the desktop Select that calls setTrash(true). Keep the bottom link only when the list is short. (src/components/notes/NotesList.tsx:160-166 and :205-216 vs :130)

items.title: Pin shows up twice in the desktop note header
items.detail: The note header has a pin button, and the … menu next to it has 'Pin to the top' too. Two controls for one rare action. Fix: Remove the header pin button and keep Pin in the … menu (Apple Notes keeps it in the menu or swipe). (src/components/notes/NoteEditor.tsx:424-428; src/components/notes/noteMenu.ts:105)

items.title: Project shows up twice in the header
items.detail: A ProjectPicker in the header and 'Move to a project' in the … menu do the same thing, which makes the header busy. Fix: Keep the header picker as a quiet chip (it shows the current project) and drop 'Move to a project' from the menu on desktop. The phone keeps the menu entry. (src/components/notes/NoteEditor.tsx:422; src/components/notes/noteMenu.ts:106)

items.title: The body placeholder is a tutorial
items.detail: 'Write here. A line can become a task: put the caret on it and tap Make task.' shows in every empty note. On desktop it also says 'tap' and points at a button that already sits in the toolbar. Fix: Use 'Start writing' (Apple Notes shows nothing). Teach Make task once with a one-time toast or the toolbar button's tooltip. (src/components/notes/NoteEditor.tsx:295)

items.title: The phone Share button opens visibility settings
items.detail: The iOS share glyph tells people to expect the system share sheet or a link. Here it opens 'Who sees it'. The aria-label even says 'Who sees it'. Fix: Use the Users or Lock icon (as whoBtn does), or make Share open a sheet with 'Who sees it' and 'Copy link' rows. (src/components/notes/NoteEditor.tsx:382-385)

items.title: 'Saved' status doesn't refresh on its own
items.detail: The status checks Date.now() - updatedAt < 8000 during render, but nothing re-renders after 8s. 'Saved' can stay up indefinitely, then jump to 'Edited … by you' at an odd moment. Fix: Keep a timer state: after an edit, set saved=true and setTimeout 8s to clear it. Cross-fade between the two lines (opacity 200ms). (src/components/notes/NoteEditor.tsx:211-218)

items.title: The phone empty filter view sends people the wrong way
items.detail: On the phone, 'No notes here yet. Tap the pen' shows when a filter (Only me, a project) hides the notes. Desktop correctly offers 'Show all notes'. Fix: When filter !== 'all', use the desktop version: 'No notes in this view' plus a 'Show all notes' link. (src/components/notes/NotesList.tsx:251 vs :157)

items.title: The swipe 'Move' action uses a chevron
items.detail: A ChevronRight in a swipe action reads as 'open' or 'more', not move to a project. Fix: Use FolderInput (the same icon as the menu's Move to a project, noteMenu.ts:106). (src/components/notes/NotesList.tsx:374)

items.title: Viewers of a shared note can't pin it
items.detail: Pin is limited to editors, so teammates who only read a shared note can't keep it at the top of their own list. Apple Notes pins per person. Fix: Store pins per user (pinnedBy: string[] or a local per-user set) and offer Pin to anyone who can see the note. (src/components/notes/NotesList.tsx:372 (start only if edit); src/components/notes/noteMenu.ts:105)

items.title: Recently deleted has no 'Delete all', and desktop rows only offer 'Put back'
items.detail: Clearing out deleted notes takes one at a time through a hidden menu or a swipe. Apple Notes has 'Delete All' in Recently Deleted. Fix: Add a 'Delete all' text button next to the 30-day note, with confirmation and a batch Undo toast. Show a quiet 'Delete' button next to 'Put back' on hover on desktop. (src/components/notes/NotesList.tsx:389-399 and :423-427)

items.title: Phone swipe deletes deleted notes for good in one gesture
items.detail: A full left swipe in Recently deleted purges the note right away. An accidental swipe destroys it, with only a short toast to recover. Fix: Make the swipe reveal a 'Delete' button that needs a tap (removes: false), or ask for confirmation in an action sheet before purge. (src/components/notes/NotesList.tsx:414)

items.title: Desktop rows show relative times under date headings
items.detail: Under 'Previous 7 days', rows say '3 days ago', which repeats the heading. The phone uses Apple's short form (13:05, Yesterday, Mon). Fix: Use whenShort(n.updatedAt) on desktop too and keep the '· by Name' suffix. (src/components/notes/NotesList.tsx:344 vs :314 (whenShort))

items.title: Pinned notes are marked twice on desktop
items.detail: Pinned notes sit under a 'Pinned' heading and also show a pin icon before the title, which is visual noise. Fix: Drop the row's pin icon whenever the Pinned heading shows (not while searching). (src/components/notes/NotesList.tsx:139 and :339)

items.title: Person chips are limited to four arbitrary people
items.detail: Search suggestions show the first four other owners in data order, not the people someone works with most, so the right person is often missing. Fix: Rank owners by number of shared notes, or by latest updatedAt, before slice(0,4). (src/components/notes/NotesList.tsx:253)

items.title: Desktop search has none of the phone's facets
items.detail: Phones can narrow a search by Pinned, Shared with me, Has tasks, project or person. Desktop only has free text, so 'notes with tasks' can't be found. Fix: Show the same nl-chip row under the desktop search field while it has focus and q is empty. (src/components/notes/NotesList.tsx:195-217 vs :254-260)

items.title: The empty note pane reads like marketing
items.detail: The no-note pane has a long pitch ('Private notes, meeting prep, how-tos… Link a note to a project…') where a calm placeholder would do. Fix: Use the title 'No note open' with no text, or a single line 'Pick a note or press New note'. (src/components/notes/NoteEditor.tsx:52)

items.title: Hold-for-redo can't be discovered
items.detail: Redo is only a 450ms long-press on Undo. Nobody will find it, and on desktop it shows only in a title. Fix: After an undo, show a separate Redo button next to Undo while redo is available, as iOS's keyboard bar does. (src/components/notes/NoteEditor.tsx:482-503)

items.title: 'New table' appears up to three times on desktop
items.detail: The sidebar has a New table compose button, the Tables home header has a primary New table, and the empty state adds a third. This breaks the 'one primary per screen' rule already applied in Drive, Calendar and Meet. Fix: Remove the header primary button (keep the sidebar's, as Drive does), and keep the empty-state button only when the sidebar is folded. (src/components/tables/TablesApp.tsx:36-39, :231-233, :243-245)

items.title: Native browser confirm() for every destructive action
items.detail: Deleting a row, rows, a column, a field, a board group, a rule or a table opens an unstyled OS dialog with no motion and no dark mode. Notes and Drive use Undo toasts instead. Fix: Delete straight away with a toast and Undo (snapshot rows, fields and tables, like App.tsx deleteForever). Use the app's own confirm sheet only for irreversible actions such as rotating secrets. (src/components/tables/TableScreen.tsx:418, :473, :1066; src/components/tables/RecordDrawer.tsx:414, :566; src/components/tables/ColumnMenu.tsx:162; src/components/tables/FieldMenu.tsx:305; src/components/tables/BoardView.tsx:393; src/components/tables/Automations.tsx:632, :775, :854)

items.title: A deleted table can't be undone
items.detail: 'This can't be undone' while the rest of the app offers Undo. Losing a whole database to one misclick is the worst case for a Notion-style tool. Fix: Keep the table and rows snapshot and show an Undo toast for 10s, or soft-delete into a Trash the way Notion does. (src/components/tables/TableScreen.tsx:417-421)

items.title: The desktop table header is crowded
items.detail: Menu, letter badge, title, project picker, Undo, Share, Automations and … all share one row. Automations is a power feature but gets the same weight as the title, and the Undo icon is unusual (Notion uses Cmd+Z only). Fix: Move Automations into the … menu (or a quiet icon), drop the header Undo button (keep Cmd+Z and Undo toasts), and keep Share as the one text button. (src/components/tables/TableScreen.tsx:629-676)

items.title: The long tip banner over the grid
items.detail: A paragraph of instructions sits above the grid for every new user, pushes the content down, and disappears with a hard cut. Fix: Cut it to one sentence ('Click a column name for its options') or turn it into a header-cell coach mark. Add .tb-tip to exitAnimations LEAVING with a collapse rule. (src/components/tables/TableScreen.tsx:938-945; src/tables.css:2123-2136; not in src/exitAnimations.ts)

items.title: New tables default to the Leads template
items.detail: Someone making a quick list gets Lead columns unless they notice the picker. Notion starts blank. Fix: Default template to 'blank' and keep the templates visible as the first choice row. (src/components/tables/TablesApp.tsx:61)

items.title: Phone home rows have no menu
items.detail: On desktop, right-clicking a table card gives Open and Copy link. On the phone, holding a row does nothing, and neither offers Rename, Duplicate or Delete from the list. Fix: Bind useActionMenu (long-press) on tb-home-row with Open, Copy link, Rename, Delete (with Undo), and add the same entries to the desktop card menu. (src/components/tables/TablesApp.tsx:208-214 vs :141-149)

items.title: Table cards show counts and the word 'fields'
items.detail: Desktop cards say 'N rows · N fields'. 'Fields' is builder jargon, and the phone already dropped counts in an earlier pass, so the two differ. Fix: Show the description or 'Edited 2h ago' instead, as in Notion's recent pages, and drop the field count. (src/components/tables/TablesApp.tsx:181)

items.title: The home header subtitle repeats itself
items.detail: 'Your own databases: leads, pipelines…' shows above existing tables every visit. It's onboarding copy that wastes space. Fix: Show the subtitle only when tables.length === 0 (the empty state already says it), or remove it. (src/components/tables/TablesApp.tsx:229)

items.title: The row drawer header has six icon buttons
items.detail: Prev, Next, Copy link, Duplicate, Delete and Close sit in a row of small icons, with Delete right next to Close where it's easy to hit by mistake. The full page already has a … menu. Fix: Keep Prev/Next and Close, and move Copy link, Duplicate and Delete into a … menu like the page view. (src/components/tables/RecordDrawer.tsx:386-419 vs :620)

items.title: The colour badge is a hidden setting
items.detail: The table's first-letter badge opens a colour picker on click. People don't expect a letter tile to be a control, and those who click it by accident get a popover. Fix: Move 'Colour' into the … table menu with the swatches inline, and make the badge non-interactive. (src/components/tables/TableScreen.tsx:634-645)

items.title: Toolbar tools lose their labels at iPad widths
items.detail: Below 1080px (iPad landscape with the sidebar open, and portrait) Sort, Group, Fields and Colours become bare icons. Group and Colours icons are ambiguous, and the labels only exist as hover titles, which touch screens never show. Fix: Below 1080px, fold Group, Fields and Colours into one 'View settings' button (labelled), and keep Filter and Sort with labels. (src/tables.css:98-105 and :106-117)

items.title: 'Colours' is a top-level toolbar button
items.detail: Conditional colours are an advanced feature but sit in the main toolbar next to Filter and Sort, which crowds the bar for everyone. Fix: Move Colours into the view settings popover (with Fields), and show a small active dot on that button when rules are on. (src/components/tables/TableScreen.tsx:852-856)

items.title: New row is split into two primary buttons
items.detail: 'New row' and its template chevron are two filled primary buttons side by side, which reads as two main actions. Fix: Style them as one split button (one fill, a 1px divider, a shared radius) so the chevron reads as part of the same control. (src/components/tables/TableScreen.tsx:859-869)

items.title: Tablet panes can switch to the phone layout
items.detail: The phone layout (cards, one bar, sheets) starts whenever the pane is under 600px. On iPad portrait (820) with the sidebar open, the pane can fall below that, so a tablet gets the phone UI. Fix: Check the pane width at 820 with the sidebar open. Either fold the sidebar automatically in Tables on tablets, or lower NARROW_PANE to about 520 and keep the desktop toolbar with the folded labels. (src/components/tables/hooks.ts:28 (NARROW_PANE = 600); src/components/tables/TableScreen.tsx:77)

items.title: View tabs overflow uses hard-coded widths
items.detail: The tab fitter reserves fixed 48px and 92px for '+' and 'N more'. Longer translations (Indonesian 'N lainnya') can overlap or clip, and tabs then jump as they move into 'more'. Fix: Measure the real widths of the more button and the add button (refs) instead of constants, and animate tabs moving into 'more' with a fade. (src/components/tables/ViewTabs.tsx:37 and :42)
